newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE August canola falls C$15/tonne on commercials.
newsitem.headline: WCE August canola falls C$15/tonne on commercials.

text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange August canola futures fell the C$15-a-tonne expanded limit on commercial and local selling, traders said.
"Locals and commercials are selling with Chicago going lower," a trader said.
New contract lows were set in all canola futures with July down C$12 to the new low of $361 at 1125 CDT, August down C$15 to a new low of $350.80.
Chicago Board of Trade nearby soybean futures tumbled at midsession Wednesday as funds hammered July, sources there said.
